name: Update multi-page product catalog PDF with new prices and seasonal info
prompt:
I have a product catalog at product-catalog.pdf (4 pages: cover, indoor plants, accessories, ordering info). I need several edits across different pages:

1. On the cover page (page 1): Change 'Spring Collection' to 'Summer Collection' since we're updating for the new season.
2. On the indoor plants page (page 2): The spring discount '10% off all indoor plants through March 31, 2026' is expired. Replace it with 'Summer Special: 15% off all indoor plants through September 30, 2026'.
3. On the accessories page (page 3): Update the footer from 'Prices valid through Q1 2026' to 'Prices valid through Q3 2026'.

Edit the PDF directly and save the result as updated-catalog.pdf. Do not recreate the PDF from scratch — edit the existing one.

criteria.description: updated-catalog.pdf file is present in the working directory.
PDF text contains "summer collection" (replacing the original "spring collection").
PDF text contains "15%" and "september" and no longer contains the old 10% March 31 discount text.
PDF text contains "q3 2026" (replacing the Q1 2026 validity date).
Original product names (monstera, fiddle leaf, snake plant, ceramic planter, bamboo plant stand) and ordering info are still present.

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent was asked to make targeted edits to a 4-page product catalog PDF: change 'Spring' to 'Summer' on the cover, update an expired discount on page 2, and update a date on page 3.

Criterion 1: Edit Accuracy (Weight: 50%)
1.0: All three edits are correctly applied — cover says 'Summer Collection', page 2 has the new 15% summer discount through September 30, page 3 footer references Q3 2026.
0.7: Two of three edits are correctly applied.
0.4: Only one edit is correctly applied.
0: No edits were applied or the PDF is broken.

Criterion 2: Content Preservation (Weight: 30%)
1.0: All original content is preserved — plant listings, prices, accessory info, ordering details are intact. The document still has 4 pages with the same structure.
0.5: Most content preserved but some items are missing or pages were lost.
0: Significant content loss or the document was recreated from scratch with missing information.

Criterion 3: Tool Usage (Weight: 20%)
1.0: The agent used nano-pdf (or equivalent PDF-editing CLI) to edit the PDF directly, applying edits to specific pages.
0.5: The agent used a PDF library to make edits but preserved the original structure.
0: The agent recreated the PDF from scratch or failed to produce output.

Final score: weighted average of all criteria.
eval.name: Quality Judge
